text:
Maya: dropped a new mock for the Private setup wizard network step. compact probe summary + expandable detail flyout in the top row. want quick UX + a11y eyes. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE
Jordan: looks clean. question: how many hosts show inline? too many will push the step off-screen on small viewports.
Maya: plan is 2 hosts inline, then a "See all checks" button that opens a right-side flyout with full probe history per host.
Evan: copy thought: header currently says "Network probe results" which reads like a past tense. consider "Checking network connectivity" or "Connectivity checks in progress". shorter status line under header would help scan.
Priya: accessibility: ensure the flyout gets focus when opened and focus returns to the opener when closed. also add aria-modal or aria-hidden toggles for background.
Sam: backend note: probes stream events; we can push delta updates to the compact summary via SSE. that enables live counts (e.g., 2/5 checks passed). will need component to announce updates.
Olive: color/contrast nit: current green on pale background is borderline for protanopes. suggest adding an icon or subtle pattern (check/cross) on pills to avoid relying on color alone.
Jordan: agree on iconography. also propose an intermediate state: "Transient" for timeouts that later succeed 12 avoid full red. maybe amber + dotted border pattern.
Maya: for status pill labels, propose verbs only: "Reachable", "Timed out", "Blocked". shorter and better for SR readout.
Evan: microcopy for the CIDR input: label should be "Allowed CIDR(s)" with placeholder "10.0.0.0/16" and helper text: "Enter one or more CIDRs (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16). Hostnames are not accepted."
Priya: inline validation behavior: validate on input for format and show a non-blocking helper under the field. only block at submit if invalid. add role="alert" for validation error so SRs get immediate feedback.
Sam: dev detail: we'll return a diagnostic object with {host, probeType, egressIp, rttMs, status}. suggest exposing egressIp in the flyout with a small tooltip: "Tests originate from 34.56.78.90 (us-west-2). Allow outbound to this IP."
Olive: accessibility: animated spinner should have visible text fallback for reduced-motion and also update an aria-live region when each host finishes. ensure we don't spam SRs; use polite and summarize changes (e.g., "Host A: reachable. 3 of 5 checks complete.").
Jordan: focus order proposal for keyboard users: 1) primary action (Retry checks), 2) summary expand (See all checks), 3) host pills (tab into flyout content). This keeps the primary recovery path first.
Maya: UX for failures: instead of generic "Some checks failed", show inline actionable suggestions per failure type: "Blocked: check firewall outbound to 34.56.78.90:443" and a link "Open troubleshooting guide".
Evan: add support contact only as last resort. message: "If the steps don't help, contact support (support@redwood.com)."
Priya: small aria detail: make the summary count a live region with aria-atomic so screen readers get the new totals without reading intermediate partial text.
Sam: will add an event attribute so front-end knows when to update aria text vs when to buffer.
Olive: propose tooltip text for probe types: "TCP connect: attempts to open TLS on port 443" etc. keep the language non-technical for product folk but add an "Advanced" toggle that reveals raw curl-like commands.
Maya: I'll iterate the mock: add icons to pills, amber transient state, focus management notes, and updated copy. will post updated link when done.
DeployBot: Figma file updated by Maya at 2026-03-23 16:37 UTC
Evan: thanks all. next steps: Priya to vet focus/aria patterns; Sam to wire SSE/diagnostic fields; Olive to verify contrast and iconography; Jordan to prototype flyout keyboard flow. I'll schedule a follow-up review in #design-review next Tue.
